en.headline: Lam says Hong Kong will form task force to speed Greater Bay Area rule alignment
en.dek: The Secretary for Justice told a dispute resolution summit that the group is expected to start work with the mainland early next year.
body: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam Ting-kwok said Hong Kong would continue to support the development of dispute resolution services in the Greater Bay Area, including the establishment of a task force to accelerate the alignment of rules and mechanisms among Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao.

Speaking at the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Dispute Resolution Summit on Sunday, Lam said the task force would be coordinated by the Deputy Secretary for Justice and involve relevant policy bureaux. It is expected to be formed by the end of this year or early next year and to begin work with the mainland in early 2027.

He said Hong Kong would promote complementary strengths in the three places’ arbitration systems, establish a platform to promote Greater Bay Area arbitration and mediation standards, and study the path towards model arbitration rules for the region.

Lam noted that the three places released Greater Bay Area arbitrator and mediator lists last December, covering 143 arbitrators and 233 mediators. The Department of Justice’s Hong Kong International Legal Talent Training Institute has provided capacity-building programmes to more than 5,000 people worldwide since 2024, including over 240 mainland judges.

zh.headline: 林定國指將成立專組加快粵港澳大灣區規則衡接
zh.dek: 律政司司長在大灣區爭議解決峰會表示，專組預計今年底或明年初成立，明年初與內地展開工作。
body: 律政司司長林定國表示，香港將繼續積極配合粵港澳大灣區爭議解決服務發展，包括成立加快三地規則衡接和機制對接的專組。
林定國星期日在粵港澳大灣區爭議解決峰會致辭時說，專組將由律政司副司長統籌，涉及相關政策局，預計今年底或明年初成立，並於明年初與內地展開相關工作。
他指，香港將推動三地仲裁制度優勢互補，設立大灣區仲裁及調解標準推廣平台，並研究制定粵港澳大灣區仲裁示範規則的路徑。
林定國提及，三地去年12月發布《粵港澳大灣區仲裁員名冊》及《粵港澳大灣區調解員名冊（2025年）》，分別涵蓋143名仲裁員及233名調解員。律政司重點發展的香港國際法律人才培訓學院自2024年成立以來，已為全球逾5000人提供能力建設項目，其中逾240名內地法官參與研修。
